scope: Engineering smoke of an opaque coach and the existing hybrid native learner; not a graph-native autonomy or KRK mastery claim.

pool.curation: legal KRK with an available mate; only positions exported

training.exercise: mate within one own move; +1 mate, -1 exercise failure

interpretation: The training command stopped safely at its 120-second wall budget (122.595 seconds including the final transaction/checkpoint), before its 256-attempt ceiling.
Every training start was distinct: this smoke covered only 196 of the 256 training positions, less than one epoch.
The fresh greedy policy abstained on all 128 validation positions. This is not a random-play baseline.
Post-training greedy evaluation solved 67/128 (52.34375%) with learning disabled and no illegal moves or abstentions.
The 128 validation rows span 25 reflection/rotation orbits, so they are not 128 independent geometric families.
Validation is now development data. The reserved test was not evaluated.
The fixed longer experiment remains unrun. This result does not establish mastery, robust replication, full KRK, or a fully persistent graph-owned selector.
reproduce: Use the default prepare seed/counts, initialize seed 1 with --episodes 0, evaluate validation, resume with --episodes 196 --wall-seconds 0 --checkpoint-every 64, then evaluate validation. Source/runtime fingerprints and pinned requirements must match.
